records.title: TPP-SD: Accelerating Transformer Point Process Sampling with Speculative Decoding
records.reason: TPP-SD applies speculative decoding to temporal point-process event sampling and reports 1.5–5.8x sampling speedups. It targets event-process sampling, not LLM token decoding.

records.title: All is Not Lost: LLM Recovery without Checkpoints
records.reason: This recovers LLM training after failures without checkpoints; it targets training recovery rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: Skrull: Towards Efficient Long Context Fine-tuning through Dynamic Data Scheduling
records.reason: Dynamic data scheduling improves long-context fine-tuning; it is a training intervention and reports no inference-serving improvement.

records.title: Communication-Efficient Diffusion Denoising Parallelization via Reuse-then-Predict Mechanism
records.reason: Reuse-then-predict parallelizes diffusion denoising, not autoregressive LLM inference.

records.title: Scaling Context, Not Parameters: Training a Compact 7B Language Model for Efficient Long-Context Processing
records.reason: MegaBeam-Mistral-7B studies long-context training/quality up to 512K on HELMET/RULER/BABILong. The reviewed text reports no inference latency, throughput, or memory gains.
